what_happened: The operator changed verifier_timeout_s in athena.toml by hand. That moved the digest of the real config, and a test that compared against a pinned digest of the real athena.toml started failing. The failure hit every job and main's CI. The operator then rewrote the test by hand, outside a job. It now builds the reading_inputs digest with and without [job_plan] and compares the two. That keeps its purpose: the [job_plan] section must not change a reading's digest. No job failed in this event.
cause: The test coupled a property about one section ([job_plan] must not move the digest) to the exact bytes of the live config. Any edit to any field therefore broke it. Nothing in the repo separates tests that need fixed fixtures from the real config, and nothing runs the full test suite when a config is edited by hand. The breakage showed up only after it had blocked every job and main's CI.
prevention: Add a policy test or lint over the test suite. Tests must not assert a hard-coded value (a digest, hash or count) computed from the live athena.toml. They must use a fixture config or compare variants built from the current config. Also make the policy tests run on any change to athena.toml, including hand edits, as a pre-commit or CI gate. Then a config-sensitive test is caught when it is written, and a config edit that breaks one is caught before it lands.
proposed_request: Audit the repo's tests for assertions that pin a value derived from the real athena.toml (digests, hashes, counts, exact field values). Rewrite each so it either uses a fixture config or compares variants built from the current config, so that an unrelated edit such as changing verifier_timeout_s cannot break it. Add a policy test that fails when a test pins a value computed from the live athena.toml. Also make sure the policy test suite runs on every change to athena.toml, including commits made outside a job. Acceptance: changing verifier_timeout_s to another value leaves the full test suite green, and the new policy test fails when a pinned-digest test of the real athena.toml is added.
